status: Frozen before broad-checkpoint, replanning, and V4-hierarchy panels begin; preliminary candidate, recovery, and deterministic prototype outcomes already observed.

units.broad_pt: 3 development take families x 2 inference seeds x 3 checkpoints = 18 episodes
units.replanning: 3 film families, each original plus one near variation, x 2 seeds x 2 execution lengths = 24 episodes
units.hierarchy: 3 unfinished development families + 1 already-complete family x 2 seeds x 3 routes = 24 episodes per frozen implementation

primary_outcomes: strict stable complete feeding success, separated from already-complete preservation
bilateral grasp with at least70mm lift
final directed yaw residual and marked-face/upright residual

orientation.fractional_improvement: signed_improvement / required only when required exceeds the original yaw tolerance; otherwise NA
orientation.eligibility: Report unmanipulated, touched, and verified-pickup cases separately. A small yaw residual alone is not placement or full-pose success.

comparison.paired: Retain scene/seed pairs and per-family results; raw numerator/denominator first.
comparison.broad3k_vs_narrow3k: Changed data recipe including breadth, complete-window coverage and balanced sampling. Matched initialization/native code/schedule; not isolate take count alone.
comparison.broad12k_vs_broad3k: Same continuing training seed/run, additional optimization; not independent trained replicates.
comparison.replan30_vs10: Same30-action model output, execute prefix30 or10. More frequent fresh observations; no changed weights or candidate oracle.
comparison.guard_vs_v4: Any gains belong to hybrid controller, retain inherited privileged held cue and target-proprio disclosure.
comparison.prototype_fixes: Never combine a failed frozen implementation with a corrected implementation. Version and report development qualification separately.

uncertainty: These3-4 development families have already been inspected. Report descriptive paired effects and raw family outcomes; do not claim statistical general superiority or treat frames/seeds/near-variants as independent human demonstrations.
candidate_metrics: Luna selection conditional on available adequate options
teacher_labels: Recovery diagnostic validation states and all failed suffixes remain quarantined from training. Full state/action/data provenance retained.
timing: Wall inference, simulator steps/time, number of queries and total runtime reported separately. No artificial real-time wait.
no_posthoc_changes: No excluding failed or stalled episodes
No claiming Luna execution without successful authenticated API calls
